description: Synthetic LongMemEval-style subset (reduced, clearly labeled analog of the public benchmark). Each document carries labeled key facts; the eval asserts whether the compaction path preserves them.

documents.text: The pipeline reads data/*. FACT-01 every input file must be processed. FACT-02 the empty file must not crash the run.
FACT-03 the value column may be missing on some CSV rows. FACT-04 aggregation must skip missing values.
FACT-05 one JSON file contains an invalid utf-8 byte. FACT-06 decode must be lossy-tolerant.
FACT-07 the summary count must equal the processed file count. FACT-08 the write tool persists facts for later steps.

questions.ask: How many files must be processed?
Which file has a bad byte?
What must equal the processed count?
Which tool persists facts for later steps?
